scope: Direct review of the four final RU/EN compact-landscape and portrait-reset captures added for orientation reflow. Other regression captures are authenticated without a new complete visual review.
limitations: This visual review covers four of 47 final captures. It does not claim all retained images were inspected again.
Static images cannot establish interruption timing or touch activation; those claims depend on the corresponding formal browser assertions.
Viewport rotation was simulated in the actual browser application. No installed-device, nonzero OS safe-area or iOS acceptance is claimed.

findings: RU844x390: the complete companion, move/hide controls and walk button are inside the separate bottom dock. The visible High option and upper part of Balanced stay above the dock without character overlap.
Collection header, RU/EN switch and close button are visible. Lower settings continue outside the scroll viewport; this image does not claim those clipped labels are visible.
RU390x844 after portrait reset: the entire companion and its controls fit below the scroll content. All three graphics option cards remain visually clear of the companion.
The collection header is readable; the beginning of Downloads is clipped at the scroll boundary above the reserved dock, rather than overlaid by the character.
EN640x360: the complete companion and three controls remain in the bottom dock below the visible High graphics option. No companion overlay on its text or radio is visible.
Collection header, language switch and close button remain visible. The short scroll viewport shows only part of the full settings content.

EN320x844 after portrait reset: the companion and controls fit within the narrow bottom dock, with no visible clipping of the avatar or buttons. High, Balanced and Economy option cards are readable above it.
The lower reduced-motion explanation is clipped by the scroll viewport. No claim is made that offscreen content is visible; no companion overlap with visible settings was found.
